svg.aria-label: kazi — Web pages and PDFs in, clean Markdown out. A small personal Firecrawl: scrape, map and crawl sites into Markdown, read PDFs page by page, extract JSON to a schema with Claude and search the web — from the terminal or a token-guarded web UI.
